prompt:
Write a Python 3 command line script logsum.py in the current folder (standard library only). It is run as `python logsum.py <logfile>` and prints a summary of the log file.

Each log line looks like this:
2024-03-05T10:15:30 ERROR api: connection refused
That is a timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), one space, a level that is exactly one of ERROR, WARN, INFO or DEBUG (uppercase only), one space, a service name made of lowercase letters, digits, underscore or hyphen, a colon, one space, and then the message, which can be anything and can contain colons. Lines may end with \n or \r\n. Lines that are empty or contain only whitespace are ignored and are not counted at all. Every other line that does not match the format is malformed: it is skipped and counted as skipped. Lines are not guaranteed to be in time order.

Output format, exactly, one item per line, nothing else:
total: <number of valid lines>
ERROR: <count>
WARN: <count>
INFO: <count>
DEBUG: <count>
skipped: <number of malformed lines>
first: <earliest timestamp>
last: <latest timestamp>
top services:
  <service>: <count>
with these rules:
- The four level lines are always printed in the order shown, with 0 when there are none.
- The "skipped:" line is printed only when at least one malformed line exists, and goes right after the DEBUG line.
- "top services:" is followed by up to 3 lines, each indented with exactly two spaces, listing the services with the most valid lines, highest count first, and ties broken alphabetically by service name.
- If there are no valid lines at all, print only "total: 0" (followed by the "skipped:" line if there are malformed lines) and nothing else.

Exit code is 0 on success, even when lines were skipped. If no file argument is given, print `usage: python logsum.py <logfile>` to stderr and exit with code 2. If the file cannot be read, print `error: cannot read <path>` to stderr (using the path as it was given) and exit with code 2.

Example output:
total: 6
ERROR: 1
WARN: 2
INFO: 3
DEBUG: 0
skipped: 2
first: 2024-03-05T09:00:00
last: 2024-03-05T11:30:10
top services:
  api: 3
  db: 2
  web: 1
